question: Should this signed marketplace feed slice be required to enforce sequence/freshness rollback protection and preserve signed profile verification across URL overrides before merge?
rationale: This PR creates a new hosted marketplace feed trust boundary, and automation cannot safely decide whether maintainers want to accept the current rollback and URL-override trust gaps as temporary series debt.

options.title: Require trust repairs before merge
options.body: Block merge until signed refresh rejects stale sequence/freshness updates and feedUrl plus feedProfile cannot drop signed verification.

options.title: Accept the staged trust gap
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge this slice with visible follow-up debt, but signed feed consumers would carry rollback and URL-override bypass risk.

options.title: Pause behind the trust stack
options.body: Keep this PR open behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98299 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98316 until the predecessor trust contracts are settled.

recommendation.title: Require trust repairs before merge
recommendation.body: Block merge until signed refresh rejects stale sequence/freshness updates and feedUrl plus feedProfile cannot drop signed verification.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned, provided the current trust-boundary review findings, and already performed branch repair work.
